description: Two paragraphs stacked in the same column, drawn at the same size. Their translations differ in length, so one needs a smaller size to fit and the other does not - and left to decide separately they end up visibly different, which reads as a mistake rather than as a decision. Whatever size the pair settles at, they settle at it together. The sharing is stated as a group as well as a band, because a band proves both sizes are allowed rather than that they are the same.
